# PrimeDex

> The most complete online Pokédex on the open web. Browse all 1025 Pokémon with detailed base stats, evolution chains, abilities, moves, type matchups, competitive builds, team builder, side-by-side comparison, and TCG cards. Available in 9 languages, free, fast, and beautifully designed.

## Short Facts
- **Pokémon covered**: 1,025 (Generations I–IX, complete National Dex)
- **Total base stats in database**: 1,025 × 6 = 6,150 stat entries
- **Distinct types**: 18 (Normal, Fire, Water, Electric, Grass, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel, Fairy)
- **Distinct abilities**: 300+ across all Pokémon
- **Languages supported**: 9 (en, fr, de, es, it, ja, ko, zh, pt)
- **TCG cards indexed**: 25,000+ across all sets
- **Page load (LCP, p75)**: < 2.5s on 4G (Next.js 16 + edge cache)
- **Data freshness**: revalidated every 3600s (1 hour)
- **License**: MIT (code), non-commercial fan project
- **First launched**: January 2024

## Agentic Browsing

### Page Structure
- Primary URL: https://primedex.vercel.app/en
- Navigation: Fixed header with language selector, theme toggle, search bar, main navigation links
- Main content: Pokédex grid (1,025 Pokémon with lazy-loaded cards), hero section with search/filters, recently viewed section, FAQ accordion
- Layout: Single-page app shell with client-side routing via Next.js App Router

### Key Pages
- Home (/en): Complete Pokédex listing with type/generation/region filters, search, infinite scroll
- Pokemon Detail (/en/pokemon/{name}): Full stats, evolution chain, moves, abilities, TCG cards, encounters, competitive builds
- Team Builder (/en/team): Drag-and-drop 6-Pokémon team with type coverage analysis and synergy scoring
- Compare (/en/compare): Side-by-side comparison of up to 3 Pokémon with interactive stat radar charts
- TCG Catalog (/en/tcg): Trading card catalog with set, rarity, type, stage, and HP filters
- Type Chart (/en/types): Interactive type effectiveness matrix for all 18 types
- Moves (/en/moves): Complete moves database with power, accuracy, PP, and effect details
- Quiz (/en/quiz): "Who's That Pokémon?" with 6 modes (Classic, Silhouette, Stats, Time Attack, Survival, Marathon)
- Battle Simulator (/en/battle): Turn-based battle simulator against AI opponents
- Breeding Calculator (/en/breeding): Egg move calculator and breeding chain planner

### Interactive Elements
- Search: Instant search across 1,025 Pokémon by name or National Dex number
- Filters: Type, generation, region, height, weight, BST range, egg groups, legendary/mythical status
- Theme: Light/dark/system toggle (persisted to IndexedDB)
- Language: 9 languages with auto-detection from browser settings
- Collections: Favorites, caught Pokémon, team slots, compare list (persisted to IndexedDB + Supabase sync)
- TCG: Card collection tracking, wishlist, price history charts

### Data Sources
- PokéAPI REST (https://pokeapi.co/api/v2): Pokémon species, stats, moves, abilities, encounters
- PokéAPI GraphQL (https://beta.pokeapi.co/graphql/v1beta): Localized names, flavor text, batch queries
- TCGdex API (https://api.tcgdex.net/v2): Trading card catalog, sets, card details
- Supabase: User authentication, cloud sync for collections and preferences

### Client-Side State
- Zustand store persisted to IndexedDB via idb-keyval
- TanStack Query for server state caching (staleTime: 10 min, gcTime: 60 min)
- Service Worker (PWA) with offline fallback for previously visited pages

## About
PrimeDex (https://primedex.vercel.app) is a high-performance, open-source Pokémon dashboard built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TanStack Query. It serves as a comprehensive reference for competitive Pokémon players, TCG collectors, and fans. The project is available on GitHub at https://github.com/teefloo/Poke and is not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, or The Pokémon Company.

## Core Features
- Complete Pokédex of all 1025 Pokémon across 9 generations with localized names in 9 languages
- Team Builder with type coverage analysis, shared weakness detection, and synergy scoring
- Side-by-side comparison of up to 3 Pokémon with interactive stat radar charts
- Type Chart with strengths, weaknesses, resistances, and immunities for all 18 types
- Moves database with detailed power, accuracy, PP, and effect information
- Pokémon TCG catalog with set, rarity, type, stage, and HP filters
- "Who's That Pokémon?" quiz with 6 modes: Classic, Silhouette, Stats, Time Attack, Survival, Marathon
- Living Dex Tracker for personal collection management (local storage)
- Search and advanced filtering by generation, type, BST, egg groups, special status

## Data Sources (Authoritative Citations)
- **PokéAPI** (https://pokeapi.co) — Pokémon species, base stats, moves, abilities, encounters, evolution chains. REST + GraphQL endpoints.
- **TCGdex** (https://www.tcgdex.net) — Pokémon Trading Card Game catalog (cards, sets, rarities, images).
- **PokéAPI GraphQL** (https://beta.pokeapi.co/graphql) — Localized species names and flavor text in 9 languages.

All data is fetched server-side and cached with `revalidate=3600`. Origin sources are credited on every Pokémon page.

## Languages
The site is fully localized in 9 languages: English (en), French (fr), German (de), Spanish (es), Italian (it), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Simplified Chinese (zh), and Brazilian Portuguese (pt). Each page declares `hreflang` alternates and an `x-default` pointing to `/en`.
